artwork.coverPrompt:
Create the ARTWORK ONLY for a full outside wrap cover of an A4 Krakow museum passport, chosen PAPER THEATER style. Use provided image solely as style reference for its layered paper-cut architecture and palette. DO NOT reproduce presentation board, sticker, letters, logo or bird. This is a new complete FLAT PRINTABLE WRAP, NOT a photo or mockup.
Canvas landscape ratio 420:297, request resolution 3840x2720. Canvas fills entire image with warm ivory matte paper #fff8f3; subtle tactile paper texture. No outside margins, no page outlines, no shadows around the outside canvas.
CRITICAL PRINT GEOMETRY: left HALF is BACK COVER; right HALF is FRONT COVER. Imaginary vertical fold at EXACTLY 50% image width. No spine strip, no text, no graphic line at fold. Keep central 4% width calm ivory and free of critical buildings. Continuous quiet ivory background across both halves.
RIGHT HALF / FRONT COVER: keep top 24% of height completely blank ivory for later typeset title. Between x=55% and 96%, y=27% to 88% compose an elegant large layered cut-paper gothic museum portal, sage shutters open to a miniature Krakow architectural diorama: Wawel Castle complex on its hill at top, Sukiennice arcades below left, recognizable pair of UNEQUAL St Mary's Church towers at lower right. Intricate tasteful matte paper relief, soft shallow physical layer shadows, no glossy plastic. Warm orange roofs #f5842c, sage #7a9d8f foliage, muted slate blue #8a9aa8 sky in arch, cream stone. Not fantasy generic castle, no extra turrets. Keep right-half bottom 9% clear ivory for brand added later.
LEFT HALF / BACK COVER: lighter, quieter balanced composition. Upper 35% mostly blank ivory. One small elegant shallow arched paper-cut scene centered in LEFT HALF (center x=25%), between y=39% and 75%, featuring a coherent view of Sukiennice arcades with one sage tree and a tiny warm orange architectural detail; much smaller and calmer than front. Beneath it a few paper foliage shapes, no collage tiles, no stickers, no labels. Leave bottom 14% blank ivory for brand added later.
Refined inviting boutique travel publication, cohesive paper craftsmanship, realistic cut-paper edges with subtle relief, enough empty paper to breathe, no dirt, no sepia aging, no gold foil, no ribbons.
ABSOLUTE: zero text, zero letters, zero numbers, zero watermark, zero website URL, zero brand mark, zero birds, no fake QR. Do not invent or draw MeTravel logo. All typography and genuine logo will be placed separately in print layout.
artwork.firstAtlasPrompt:
Create a PRODUCTION ART ATLAS of 16 separate museum-theme PAPER THEATER illustrations, 4 columns by 4 rows, perfectly even grid, white background, square 2048x2048. Every illustration centered within its own equal square cell with at least 16% quiet margin on ALL edges, no bleed into adjacent cells. NO visible grid, NO text, NO numbers, NO logos, NO birds, NO website, NO lettering. We will cut out cells and add correct museum names and original brand ourselves.
Match the reference's matte layered paper-cut craftsmanship: intricate tactile cut-paper layers, small shallow shadows, sage #7a9d8f, warm orange #f5842c, cream #fff8f3 and slateblue #8a9aa8, charcoal details. Refined travel collector stickers, not generic clip art, every motif visually unique. Use restrained simple symbolic compositions; illustrations interpret museum themes rather than claim to reproduce exact historic artifacts.
CRITICAL ORDER left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
row1: 1 Wawel royal castle on a green hill, recognizable not fantasy; 2 framed Renaissance portrait of a woman holding a white ermine, tasteful small symbolic art; 3 medieval underground market excavation with stone arch and ceramic vessel; 4 one vintage propeller aeroplane.
row2: 5 respectful enamel factory doorway with one enamel pot and historical paper document, no symbols of hatred, solemn not playful; 6 intricate orange and sage stained glass panel inside arched window; 7 historic tram wheel and a small gear; 8 vintage bellows camera.
row3: 9 modern framed abstract Polish art painting and small ceramic vase; 10 prism splitting a soft beam of light in a dark-blue arch; 11 astronomical globe with old university arch; 12 contemporary sculpture and abstract geometric artwork on plinth.
row4: 13 antique pharmacy jars and mortar pestle; 14 retro arcade game cabinet with abstract screen and no lettering; 15 Krakow Christmas nativity architectural model with colorful towers no letters; 16 a retro pinball machine viewed front-threequarter with a small ball.
No generated labels or outside presentation board. A true clean even 4x4 atlas, not a collage with different cell dimensions. No cropped objects. Leave white negative space around each object for easy sticker placement.

additionalAtlasPrompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production museum sticker artwork in the approved PAPER THEATER style. Match the reference: intricate layered cut-paper objects, matte cream paper, shallow realistic paper-edge relief, warm orange #f5842c, sage #7a9d8f, slateblue #8a9aa8, warm ivory. Sophisticated boutique travel collection, coherent visual scale. WHITE background, NO text, NO lettering, NO numbers, NO brand or logo, NO birds except when specifically a museum theme. Theme symbols are artistic interpretations, not documentary replicas of actual exhibits or architecture. For wartime memorials use solemn symbolic architecture/candle/document, no cheerful or violent characters, no hateful symbols. For torture-history museums show an old closed iron door and key, no devices or injuries. Religious collection can be a manuscript, chalice or arch, no inaccurate portrait claims. Avoid generic same-arch repetition: each theme must have distinctive relevant main object. No extra unrelated landmarks.
Square2048x2048 atlas EXACT4columns x4rows,16equally sized cells. Every illustration centered completely INSIDE its own square cell, at least15% clear white margin all around. No grid lines, no touching neighboring objects, no overflowing any cell. Order left to right then top to bottom STRICTLY:
1. Manggha: Японские гравюры, керамика, искусство и культура Восточной Азии.
2. MNK Sukiennice: Польская живопись и скульптура XIX века в залах над торговыми рядами.
3. Cricoteka: Театр Тадеуша Кантора, сценические объекты и экспериментальное искусство.
4. Muzeum Armii Krajowej: Польское подполье, сопротивление и история Армии Крайовой.
5. Muzeum Archeologiczne: Археология и древняя история Малопольши; доступность выставок зависит от ремонта.
6. Muzeum Podgórza: История самостоятельного города Подгуже, его жителей, промышленности и улиц.
7. Apteka pod Orłem: Аптека Тадеуша Панкевича, память о краковском гетто и его жителях.
8. Muzeum Elektroniki: Ретрокомпьютеры, приставки, электроника; многие устройства можно попробовать.
9. Cogiteon: Интерактивный научный центр: эксперименты, лаборатории и человек как часть природы.
10. Żywe Muzeum Obwarzanka: История краковского обважанка и практический мастер-класс по его приготовлению.
11. Muzeum Geologiczne ING PAN: Минералы, горные породы, окаменелости и геологическая история Земли.
12. Krakil – Muzeum Iluzji: Оптические иллюзии, зеркала, перевёрнутая комната и фотозоны.
13. Van Gogh & Vincent: Иммерсивная биографическая выставка о Ван Гоге; не собрание оригинальных полотен.
14. Dom Esterki: Временные этнографические выставки в историческом доме.
15. Muzeum Etnograficzne: Традиционный быт, костюмы, ремёсла, обряды и интерьеры сельских домов.
16. Podziemna Nowa Huta – Szkolne 22: Убежище времён холодной войны и история защиты населения.
